title: Cap. VIII Arg. 4: will to show wrath (Rom. 9:22) said to presuppose sins as cause of reprobation
pass_a_gloss: The Apostle says that God, when he reprobates, wills to show wrath and vengeance, etc. Rom. 9:22. But the will of inflicting vengeance presupposes that a man be considered by God as bound by sins: Therefore the sins of the reprobate, by which they die bound, are the cause of reprobation.
pass_b_english: Fourth: the Apostle says that when God reprobates he wills to show wrath and vengeance (Rom. 9:22). But the will to inflict vengeance presupposes that God regards a man as bound by sins. Therefore the sins by which the reprobate die bound are the cause of reprobation.
source_text: Apostolus dicit Deum, cum reprobat, velle ostendere iram et vindictam, etc. Rom. ix. 22. At voluntas inferendi vindictam praesupponit hominem considerari a Deo ut peccatis obstrictum: Ergo peccata reproborum, quibus obstricti moriuntur, sunt causa reprobationis.
